title: Reveal schedule: day 3 brings the Book and its Guide
about: QA round. A guided game on day 3 at 06:30, waking at home; the morning brought the Book ("New in the Menu: the Book, with a Guide to gold and crops.") and Rosa's letter. The coach: "New: a Guide. Tap Menu.", then "Tap Book: the new Guide.", then "Tap Gold: how money works." on the Gold page's button. Reading Gold ends it; the planting cycle's intro comes the next morning.
